verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile documents direct delegation to Copilot: assigning issues to Copilot for automated PR generation, managing Copilot 'Agent Tasks' cloud jobs, invoking Copilot code review, and natural-language chat with Copilot for code Q&A/PR creation, all within the app. This is first-party documentation only — missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of these specific Copilot delegation features (the community evidence predates Copilot integration and doesn't address it).
